name: altwise

scripts.build:web: tsc && vite build --mode web && cp -r demo privacy.html web-dist/ && node dev/check-no-token.mjs web-dist
scripts.deploy:web: npm run release && npm run build:web && cp release/altwise-extension.zip web-dist/ && npx firebase-tools@14.27.0 deploy --only hosting --project $(grep VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID .env.local | cut -d= -f2)
scripts.release: tsc && vite build --mode judges --outDir release/altwise && cd release && rm -f altwise-extension.zip && zip -qr altwise-extension.zip altwise && cd altwise && rm -f ../altwise-webstore.zip && zip -qr ../altwise-webstore.zip .

description: Chrome extension that audits page images and writes alt text with Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference
